name: Duelgrounds
storyline:
There was a time when battles were fought for territory. Then they were fought for power. Now… they are fought for survival.

Beyond the edge of civilization lies a place where legends are made and forgotten. No armies. No alliances. No second chances.

Only two fighters will enter.

Each duel begins with uncertainty. No chosen weapons. No guaranteed advantages. The battlefield decides what you receive, and your instincts decide what happens next. A weapon appears. A moment of silence.

Then the fight begins.

Every round is a test of skill, speed, and control. Adapt to the weapon in your hands. Read your opponent’s every move. Use the environment. Take risks. Make impossible choices. Because in the Duelgrounds, hesitation is defeat.

The strongest warriors are not those with the best gear. They are the ones who can turn chaos into opportunity. The ones who can master any weapon, survive any situation, and outthink anyone standing in their way.

But not every battle is fought in the open.

Some hunters hide in plain sight. Some enemies wait patiently for the perfect moment to strike. In a world where deception can be just as powerful as firepower, trust nothing and expect everything. Every duel creates a story. Every victory creates a legend. Every defeat leaves a lesson.

The weapons are ready. The only question is…

How long can you survive?

Duelgrounds.
No preparation. No excuses. Only skill.
summary: Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where every round brings a new weapon and every decision matters. Master the entire arsenal, manage limited resources, and outplay your opponents through skill, strategy, and adaptation.
